capabilities: Convert selected text to AMA title case
Handle colon and hyphenated-compound edge cases
Preserve words from a configurable exception list
extras: README states the code was written with the assistance of Gemini 3.1 Pro (High).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in text-transformation command that applies citation-style title case rules to selected text.
summary: Editor utility that converts selected text to title case following citation styles, currently AMA, with an exception list for protected words.
